d: Mokama vidhayak Anant Singh ki beti Shivangi Singh ki shadi ko lekar taiyariyan joron par hain. shadi samaroh ke lie banae gae bhavy pandal men rangarang sanskritik karyakramon ka aayojan hoga. bhojpuri se lekar bolivud tak ke sitaron ke shamil hone ki charcha ke bich is pandal ko khas andaj men taiyar kiya ja raha hai. dekhie shadi ke karyakramon ke lie bane is bhavy pandal ki khas jhalka.
